methodology.title: Change Controlled Operations
methodology.passage: Change Controlled Operations. Change types. * Standard changes are pre approved, low risk and repeatable, and can bypass the board. * Normal changes are assessed and approved by the change advisory board. * Emergency changes restore service urgently and are reviewed after the fact.

methodology.title: Kanban Continuous Flow
methodology.passage: Kanban Continuous Flow. When to use it. Kanban is the default for maintenance, sustaining engineering and operational support. Work arrives continuously, priorities change daily and the unit of planning is the individual work item rather than a time boxed batch. methodology.title: Workflow Selection Heuristics
methodology.passage: Workflow Selection Heuristics. Primary questions. * How much of the work is known before it starts? High uncertainty favours Scrum or dual track discovery; fixed, baselined scope favours a stage gate lifecycle. * How does work arrive? triggers.description: Prevents implementation during declared change freezes.
Rolls back automatically when error budget burn spikes.
Forces retrospective CAB review of emergency changes.
Writes an immutable, time stamped audit record for every state change.
Classifies ICT incidents against DORA major incident criteria.
